recentItems.title: Drunk History | How One Woman Created Modern Halloween (S5, E13) | Paramount+
recentItems.description:
In 1912, Elizabeth Krebs founder of the Hiawatha Garden Club in Kansas, decided to put an end to the destruction of her flower beds by throwing a town-wide party to tire out the local kids. Watch how her determination created the modern Halloween traditions of costumes, music, and trick-or-treating. Season 5, Episode 13: Halloween.

recentItems.title: It Gets Worse | Official Trailer | Paramount+
recentItems.description:
It Gets Worse premieres November 6 on the Paramount+ Premium Plan.

After being evicted from their flat, three deeply non-aspirational twenty-somethings stumble through dead-end jobs, chaotic love lives, and worsening mental health, clinging to friendship while the world – and their futures – falls apart around them. No money, no direction and absolutely no idea how to get their shit together. Surely it gets better than this, right? Spoiler alert: it doesn’t.

It Gets Worse is created and exec produced by Leo Reich and stars Reich, Emily Fairn (“House of Guinness”), Olive Gray (“Halo”) and Sean Delaney (“Killing Eve”) among its cast as well as guest stars including Lena Dunham and Andrew Scott.

UFC 334 at Madison Square Garden | Official Trailer | Paramount+
recentItems.description:
UFC 334 is taking over the The World's Most Famous Arena in New York City for a historic night of double-championship drama! Tune in for one of the most stacked cards of all time live from Madison Square Garden and watch every showdown live on November 14 at 9PM ET on Paramount+.

Records and legacies are on the line for a card that features some of combat sports' greatest icons. Capping off the night is a massive heavyweight showdown as Ciryl Gane defends his title against the division's fastest-rising star, Josh Hokit. The former NFL athlete brings a perfect 10-0 record and relentless pressure into this classic power versus speed showdown.

But the championship drama doesn't stop there with the co-main event showcasing the biggest women's fight in MMA history. In this bout, reigning UFC Women's Bantamweight Champion Kayla Harrison will defend her crown against the returning former two-division champion and consensus GOAT, Amanda Nunes. Harrison enters the cage as one of the most decorated combat sports athletes ever, boasting two Olympic gold medals in judo and a dominant run to the UFC belt. But the grappling legend now faces her ultimate test against "The Lioness", who is back to reclaim her throne and add to her unmatched legacy.
